faq.q: Can we connect our existing telematics?
faq.a: Yes — native connectors for Samsara, Geotab, Motive and others. For proprietary telematics, a standardized API ingests vehicle, driver and diagnostic data into the Trackeys live view.

faq.q: Does it handle cold chain and temperature-sensitive shipments?
faq.a: Yes. IoT temperature and humidity sensors stream continuously. Breach alerts fire in real time and full logs attach to every shipment for compliance, claims and dispute handling.

faq.q: How does the AI handle dynamic re-routing?
faq.a: When traffic, cancellations or priority changes occur, the engine re-evaluates remaining stops in seconds against time-window, vehicle and driver constraints — and pushes the updated manifest to the driver automatically.

faq.q: Can our customers track their own shipments?
faq.a: Yes. White-labeled tracking pages and real-time SMS/email updates give end customers self-service visibility without exposing internal operations.
